verdict.rationale: Buzz's own harness and Desktop-bundled managed agent turn @mentions into product operations through the Buzz CLI. The shipped buzz-cli skill covers messaging, channels, DMs, workflows, repos, canvas and memory, and it explicitly handles natural requests such as "create an agent" with an owner-review gate. Block's public benchmark grades agents doing tasks like create-channel-invite-users from ordinary-looking questions, and remote agents are steered by mentioning them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence of breadth beyond what the skill and benchmark document (e.g., admin, moderation or settings operations via natural language).
